title: entries.v1
description: Test of step 9 of bin/check.sh. FromOpenapi, ThroughEntry, FromAsyncapi and Shared are reached from openapi/ and asyncapi/ of the layout. Unused, OnlyFromUnused and OnlyFromFixture are not, and expected.txt lists them.

FromOpenapi.description: Reached from the response of openapi/documents.v1.yaml.

ThroughEntry.description: Reached only through the property of FromOpenapi.

FromAsyncapi.description: Reached from the payload of the message of asyncapi/documents.v1.yaml.

Shared.description: Reached from the response of openapi/documents.v1.yaml. other.v1.json has an entry of the same name that nothing references.

OnlyFromUnused.description: Only Unused references it, and Unused is unwalked itself: unwalked.

OnlyFromFixture.description: Only rules/fixture.yaml references it, a document outside openapi/ and asyncapi/: unwalked.
